decisions.reason: The accelerator program costs little to maintain and is visibly promoted, but it sits furthest from the core machinery business, and dropping Product B shows management will prune peripheral offerings, so its survival remains uncertain.
WASTX Cleanic is a publicly announced flagship co-developed with ERMAFA and close to core competencies, so sunk costs and partner commitment favour persisting even if early sales are modest.
The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant is central to the announced decentralized, modular recycling strategy and the WASTX line, making withdrawal very unlikely.
